item.title: security: Managing open-weight model risk in enterprise deployments
item.description:
Microsoft and NVIDIA released a whitepaper on managing risks from open-weight AI models in enterprise deployments. It proposes a shared taxonomy, evaluation methods, and controls for assessing and reducing those risks.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
